plan.title: Task progress indicator in sidebar
plan.overview: Add a progress indicator (e.g., "3/7") to each task in the sidebar kanban TreeView, showing how many plan.xml tasks are completed vs total. The implementation adds a getPlanProgress function to the plan-parser computer, threads progress data through the orchestrator into the view capability, and displays it in both description and tooltip. The existing file watcher already covers plan.xml changes, so no new watcher is needed.

approach.rationale:
Following three established patterns: 1. Computer Factory pattern at apps/vscode/src/computers/plan-parser.computer.ts:38 - getPlanProgress will be a new pure function on the existing createPlanParserComputer return type, reusing the same XMLParser instance already configured for plan.xml parsing. 2. Dependency Injection via Deps at apps/vscode/src/capabilities/tasks-view.capability.ts:230 - A new getPlanProgress dep function will be added to TasksViewCapabilityDeps, following the same pattern as checkTaskFiles. 3. Description Parts Array at apps/vscode/src/capabilities/tasks-view.capability.ts:69 - Progress indicator inserts into the parts array between file indicators (line 97) and next action arrow (line 101).
Implementation order follows planning directive P3: types first, then computer, capability, orchestrator. No new orchestrator needed - this feature extends the existing tasks domain.

task.name: Accept and display progress in tasks-view capability
task.action: - Import PlanProgress from task-types.ts - Add getPlanProgress to TasksViewCapabilityDeps interface (line 230): `getPlanProgress: (taskPath: string) => PlanProgress | undefined;` - Add progress parameter to TaskItem constructor: Change constructor signature to accept a fourth parameter: `public readonly progress: PlanProgress | undefined` - In buildDescription() (line 69), after the file indicators block (line 97) and before the next action block (line 100), add progress indicator: ```typescript if (this.progress && this.progress.total > 0) { parts.push(`${this.progress.completed}/${this.progress.total}`); } ``` - In buildTooltip() (line 108), after the Files section (line 136) and before the Next action section (line 139), add progress info: ```typescript if (this.progress && this.progress.total > 0) { md.appendMarkdown(`\n**Progress:** ${this.progress.completed}/${this.progress.total} tasks completed\n`); } ``` - Update getTasksForStatus (line 318) to call deps.getPlanProgress and pass to TaskItem: ```typescript .map((t) => new TaskItem(t, deps.checkTaskFiles(t.taskPath), deps.getAllActions(t), deps.getPlanProgress(t.taskPath))); ``` - Update findTaskItem (line 391) similarly to pass progress: ```typescript cachedTaskItems.set(task.id, new TaskItem(task, deps.checkTaskFiles(task.taskPath), deps.getAllActions(task), deps.getPlanProgress(task.taskPath))); ```
task.done: TaskItem shows "completed/total" in description after file indicators, tooltip includes progress line, no indicator shown when progress is undefined or total is 0

task.done: Orchestrator reads plan.xml and passes progress to view capability, build succeeds, no new file watcher needed
